now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
now.text: In the Framework, Fitz, now Hydra's ruthless Doctor, ignores Radcliffe's pleas to remember who he really is. He kills Agnes and takes Radcliffe prisoner.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The friend Radcliffe builds Aida with, later trapped in Radcliffe's Framework.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The friend Fitz builds Aida with, whose Framework later traps Fitz's mind.

changes.evidence: The Framework events in this stage (Fitz as Hydra's Doctor rejecting Radcliffe's appeal, killing Agnes Kitsworth and imprisoning Radcliffe) happen in S4#17 'Identity and Change'. The season-wide title 'S4' places the stage before S4#1, ahead of the Aida work (S4#1) and Radcliffe's exposed betrayal (S4#11) that its card lines refer to.

owner_calls.question: After the Framework stage (moved to S4#17), should a stage be added at S4#20 'Farewell, Cruel World!', where Radcliffe, who first helps Fitz hunt Simmons, turns on him, overpowers him and sends him back through to the real world, regretting all he has done?
options: Add an ally stage at Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#20: Radcliffe overpowers Fitz and sends him out of the Framework, regretting everything he has done since the Darkhold
owner_calls.evidence: S4#20: Fitz begins hunting Simmons with help from Radcliffe; Fitz is overpowered by Radcliffe, who regrets all his actions; Radcliffe sends Fitz through, followed by Simmons.

owner_calls.question: The connection starts at Cloak & Dagger#16, but Tandy first meets Andre in Cloak & Dagger#12 (S2E2 'White Lines') as the friendly leader of her support group, before he is revealed as her captor. Should an earlier stage be added at #12?
options: Add a friend stage at Cloak & Dagger#12: Tandy finds comfort in Andre, the friendly leader of her support group
owner_calls.evidence: S2E2 'White Lines': Tandy finds comfort in the friendly support leader, Andre Deschaine. S2E6 'B Sides': Lia is revealed to be working for Andre, who traps Tandy's mind.
